# ECO-AS-CONFIG — Compound ecosystem usage via configuration, not integration code

Research finding 1 (high confidence, verified 3-0): Ash resources are the single source of truth and extensions derive capabilities (DB schemas, GraphQL/JSON:API, admin, TypeScript) from typed introspectable actions, so maximum ecosystem usage compounds by adding configuration rather than hand-written integration code. ash_pplan's control plane already joins AshPPlan.ControlPlane/Oban/StateMachine over upstream public introspection; this order extends that configuration-only pattern to every new ecosystem surface adopted under ECO-EXT-AUDIT and ECO-REACTOR-GENERIC, and refuses per-extension glue code at call sites.

## Acceptance

- **No per-extension glue at call sites** — A census of call sites touching newly adopted extensions shows extension-declared behavior consumed directly, not re-wrapped in project-local shim modules.

- **Adoption is configuration-only** — Every newly adopted ecosystem extension lands as extension declaration + configuration; no hand-written adapter bridges framework behavior the extension already derives.


## Falsifiers

- **Hand-written integration glue observed** — Hand-written code re-implementing behavior an adopted extension derives from resources/actions (the anti-pattern the research names) falsifies the configuration-only adoption claim.

- **Parallel introspection path** — A second introspection path bypassing Ash public Info modules for an adopted extension falsifies the single-substrate claim.
